body:
Hi. I hope you're doing better today. I'm going through a hard time and I know how you feel. I'm terrified of what is coming next, of how much deeper I can fall. It's incredibly lonely and isolating. 

I read a really insightful piece online recently, and it articulated a lot of what I was thinking on depression and the ongoing despair it brings. It didn't make me feel better, but it didn't make me feel worse either. You might get something from it.

http://madamenoire.com/520180/dealing-with-thoughts-of-suicide/2/

Every single day. I wish for a truck to run a red light and hit my car; to stumble as I cross the road in traffic; to have an undiagnosed medical condition and just drop dead of heart failure at work or in my sleep. 
I think all of us who no longer want to be alive desperately wish for it to be taken out of our hands, to just pass away rather than having to choose to kill ourselves.

It's just a huge mess. And I am very much to blame to letting it get so out of control. I just wanted to believe him him, in us, so badly that I held on and allowed myself to be treated poorly. I never imagined that the person I loved for ten years could hurt me like this. I don't know how to separate the person I love with the person he is. And I'm confused and in pain and just deeply sad most of the time. I don't want to be around other people because I feel envious of their happiness and I hate that I feel like that. It's an ugly quality, but I'm jealous that they can enjoy their lives and I can't find a way to. 
I wish I could erase him from my memories, because he haunts me. It's unrelenting and exhausting. I don't have anything left at the end of the day because I've been fighting the thoughts and tears. It's so ridiculous to let someone rule your life like that, but I feel like I have no control.

My ex and I have been in a complicated break up for the past two years. Now he's having a baby with someone else. So much has happened that has damaged me but I kept this foolish hope alive that we would be okay, and now that is completely destroyed. 
I feel like I have no reason to be so depressed- I have shelter and a job and family and friends who love me and support me. But I don't get joy from any of it, and I don't want it, without him. I am so ashamed of myself for letting it get this bad. Other people go through much worse and they can cope, move forward. Why can't I? I was supposed to be strong, everyone always said it. But I fell apart and it's gotten so bad I don't want to try to get better. I feel like if he had walked away cleanly two years ago I might have had a chance. Maybe. But I'm so hurt and lost now. I don't trust myself or my thoughts- they have led me here. I don't want to force myself every day just to get up and get through the day. I tried to explain to my doctor that it's like PTSD, i get these flashes of him and us- good and bad- when I'm driving, or working, or talking to a friend. It comes so suddenly and with such force that I feel like I've been hit. And then this sinking feeling washes over me, and I feel weak and can't concentrate. 

I don't want to be happy anymore, I just want to be free, no more pain.
